groups.label: Start view
groups.description: The projection, centre and zoom level a map starts with.

groups.label: Controls
groups.description: Limits of the Map Pane's dim slider and of Zoom to.

groups.label: Performance
groups.description: How much the map draws one by one, and how often it applies changes; the defaults suit most computers.

projections.title: Projections
projections.description: The map projections the view can switch to. Each has a code, proj4 text, the projected extent and the lon/lat world extent (polar projections need both, spike S2).

x-emc2.hint: The projections the map can switch to; each has proj4 text and two extents

code.title: Code
code.description: The projection's code, which the Projection list shows, e.g. EPSG:3857.

x-emc2.hint: What the Projection list shows, e.g. EPSG:3857

proj4.title: proj4 text
proj4.description: The projection's definition as proj4 text.

extent.title: Projected extent
extent.description: The projection's extent in its own coordinates: minimum x, minimum y, maximum x, maximum y.

x-emc2.hint: The projected extent: minimum x, minimum y, maximum x, maximum y

worldExtent.title: World extent
worldExtent.description: The part of the world the projection covers, in longitude and latitude: west, south, east, north.

x-emc2.hint: The lon/lat extent it covers: west, south, east, north

initialProjection.title: Start projection
initialProjection.description: The code of the projection the map starts in; one of the configured projections.

x-emc2.hint: The projection the map starts in; one of the configured codes

initialCenter.title: Start centre
initialCenter.description: The centre the map starts at, as [longitude, latitude] in WGS84.

x-emc2.hint: Where the map starts: longitude, latitude (WGS84)

initialZoom.title: Start zoom level
initialZoom.description: The zoom level the map starts at.

textThreshold.title: Symbols with text
textThreshold.description: Up to this many visible symbols, symbols are drawn with their text (the labels the user placed and the amplifiers); above it, without text from shared images (spike S2).

x-emc2.hint: Up to this many visible symbols have their text; above it, none

updateCadenceMs.title: Update interval
updateCadenceMs.description: How often changes of a large change stream are applied to a map layer, in milliseconds (ADR-0017 point 4). Faster blocks the page more.

x-emc2.hint: How often a large change stream is drawn; faster blocks the page

preferredBackgrounds.title: Preferred backgrounds
preferredBackgrounds.description: Background map provider names in order of preference. After switching to a projection the chosen background does not support, the map takes the user's last choice for that projection, otherwise the first available one in this order.

x-emc2.hint: Background maps in order of preference, used after a projection switch

softwareBudget.title: Object budget without a GPU
softwareBudget.description: Object budget without a GPU: the most objects drawn one by one; above it the server sends clusters (ADR-0017 point 2, spike S3).

x-emc2.hint: Most objects drawn one by one without a GPU; above it, clusters

hardwareBudget.title: Object budget with a GPU
hardwareBudget.description: Object budget with a GPU: the most objects drawn one by one; above it the server sends clusters (spike S3).

x-emc2.hint: Most objects drawn one by one with a GPU; above it, clusters

highestDim.title: Highest dim level
highestDim.description: The highest level the dim slider in the Map Pane darkens the background map to, in percent (brief function 19); the slider moves in steps of 10 %.

x-emc2.hint: The highest level the dim slider darkens the map to, in steps of 10 %

zoomToWidthMetres.title: Zoom to width
zoomToWidthMetres.description: How wide Zoom to shows a single object, in metres; Zoom to never goes closer for several objects either (brief function 16).

x-emc2.hint: How wide Zoom to shows one object; it goes no closer for several
